smb.s_connection.title: Connection
smb.s_connection.host.label: Server
smb.s_connection.host.description: SMB server hostname or IP (no slashes).
smb.s_connection.share.label: Share
smb.s_connection.share.description: Share name as exported by the server, without slashes.
smb.s_connection.port.label: Port
smb.s_connection.username.label: Username
smb.s_connection.username.description: Leave empty for a guest (anonymous) connection.
smb.s_connection.password.label: Password
smb.s_connection.domain.label: Domain / Workgroup
smb.s_connection.domain.description: Optional. Required by some AD-joined servers.
smb.s_connection.maxProtocol.label: Max protocol
smb.s_connection.maxProtocol.description: Optional dialect ceiling, e.g. SMB3. Set this when a server negotiates a dialect the client mishandles.
smb.s_storage.title: Storage
smb.s_storage.basePath.label: Directory in share
smb.s_storage.basePath.description: Directory inside the share where files are written. Leave empty for the share root. Created if missing.
webdav.s_connection.title: Connection
webdav.s_connection.url.label: WebDAV URL
webdav.s_connection.authMethod.label: Authentication method
webdav.s_connection.username.label: Username
webdav.s_connection.password.label: Password
webdav.s_connection.token.label: Bearer Token
webdav.s_storage.title: Storage
webdav.s_storage.basePath.label: Remote Path
webdav.s_storage.basePath.description: Subdirectory under the WebDAV root where files are written. Created if missing.
s3.s_connection.title: Connection
s3.s_connection.endpoint.label: Endpoint URL
s3.s_connection.endpoint.description: Leave empty for AWS S3. Set for Minio / R2 / Backblaze (e.g. https://nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com).
s3.s_connection.region.label: Region
s3.s_connection.bucket.label: Bucket
s3.s_connection.accessKeyId.label: Access Key ID
s3.s_connection.secretAccessKey.label: Secret Access Key
s3.s_connection.forcePathStyle.label: Force path-style addressing
s3.s_connection.forcePathStyle.descripti: Required for Minio and Cloudflare R2. AWS S3 should leave this off.
s3.s_storage.title: Storage
s3.s_storage.basePath.label: Key Prefix
s3.s_storage.basePath.description: Optional prefix prepended to every object key. Leave empty to use the bucket root.
sftp.s_connection.title: Connection
sftp.s_connection.host.label: Host
sftp.s_connection.port.label: Port
sftp.s_connection.username.label: Username
sftp.s_connection.authMethod.label: Authentication method
sftp.s_connection.password.label: Password
sftp.s_connection.privateKey.label: Private Key (PEM)
sftp.s_connection.hostKeyFingerprint.des: Pin the server fingerprint (sha256:...) to mitigate MITM. Leave blank to accept any.
sftp.s_storage.title: Storage
sftp.s_storage.basePath.label: Remote Path
sftp.s_storage.basePath.description: Absolute remote directory where files are written. Created if missing.
